race.title: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: BARBURY BOY found only an odds-on favourite too strong on his hurdling debut at Plumpton recently so, with improvement on the cards, Alan King's charge gets the vote to go one better. The penalised Thisonesforyou looks an obvious threat having made the perfect start for new connections earlier in the month, with Aukus and Pantile's Gift taken to fight out minor honours. BARBURY BOY THISONESFORYOU AUKUS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Aukus (7/2), James Choice (9/2), Thisonesforyou (6/1), Barbury Boy (6/1), Temple (7/1), Mathoura (10/1), Pantile's Gift (10/1), Stepanov (10/1), John Harrison (14/1), Kiss For An Angel (20/1)
